_comment: The cockpit's own map, for the assistant: every view and control, where it is and what it does. Keep it in step with the page: the cockpit tests check that every view here is in the page's route table (core.js PAGE_ROUTES) with the same route, and that every control appears as data-control.

views.label: Home
views.purpose: the dashboard for your lens: key figures, decisions waiting, the delivery square, health and more, in your own layout

views.label: Delivery square
views.purpose: needs arriving from the operation, concepts to validate, the factory, end-user feedback and what runs in production

views.label: Capability catalogue
views.purpose: every capability: in use, pilot or proposed, what it does, and whether its capability pack is valid

views.label: Projects
views.purpose: every project with its state, now line and health

views.label: All decisions
views.purpose: every card you may decide across projects, including updates and concepts, by kind, project or age

views.label: Insight (Floor)
views.purpose: the factory across all projects: gate pass rate, pipeline, models, spend

views.label: Settings
views.purpose: the modules in use, embeds for websites, appearance, and sign-in links for another tab

views.label: Shape it in chat
views.purpose: work out a need with Rihma in conversation: start from nothing, a sentence or a file, see a draft brief take shape beside the chat and edit it, then create the project from it

views.label: Models setup
views.purpose: which model answers for each role: its endpoint, model name and API key, local or hosted, with a Test that sends a tiny prompt

views.label: Runners (cell runners)
views.purpose: which harness runs the factory's cells: Gnomon, which enforces the rules during a run, or another harness (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or a command you name) that IT approves on a card with its version pinned and that is checked after every run; per project and per role

views.label: Overview
views.purpose: a project's health, forecast, now line and what waits on you

views.label: Inbox
views.purpose: the cards you may decide, with the verdicts you may give

views.label: Questions
views.purpose: the panel's questions with options; answer or let Rihma assume

views.label: Assumptions
views.purpose: what Rihma assumed, with due dates; confirm or refute

views.label: Plan
views.purpose: the plan waiting for approval; edit a requirement, approve or reject with a reason

views.label: Spec & contract
views.purpose: requirements and criteria with sources and evidence chips

views.label: Tasks
views.purpose: the task board, timeline or table, and the live view of the running cell

views.label: Cell
views.purpose: every Gnomon run: role, model, verdict, chain, tokens, cost

views.label: Releases
views.purpose: deliveries with their capability pack: environments, holdouts, shadow, canary

views.label: Try it
views.purpose: the checklist against the running release, and reporting what you saw

views.label: Changes
views.purpose: report a change or feedback; see triage and impact

views.label: Ledger
views.purpose: every recorded event, who acted, and whether the chain is intact

views.label: Evidence
views.purpose: the attestation, the control table and the evidence pack export, for compliance

views.label: Jobs
views.purpose: background runs started from the cockpit

views.label: Track
views.purpose: whether a project stays on track against its approved plan, every figure with its basis, the human checkpoints a person looks at, the autopilot in a sandbox and the delegations

views.label: Outputs
views.purpose: what each audience receives: choose the outputs, then build and download them from the project's records and its release (a web app with sign-in, a container, an API description, a delivery report, an evidence pack, the source). A choice made with the new-project request is told to intake, never asked again, and kept in the brief; with sign-in, a factory check the sign-in turns away says not measured (docs/guides/outputs.md)

views.label: Assessment
views.purpose: an adopted system judged from five perspectives (CI/CD governance, maintenance, security, compliance, architecture and operations), each finding with its evidence, severity and a suggested change; versions compared; findings filed as changes

views.label: Automations
views.purpose: every automation across the factory, with scope filters: a trigger (a schedule, a recorded event, an inbound webhook ringing, new commits on a branch), an optional guard, an action and a scope, run with its owner's rights; templates, pause and resume, run now, a dry run and the history of runs. An automation never decides a card (docs/guides/automations.md)

views.label: Automations (project)
views.purpose: the automations that reach one project, its tags, and what ran on it, with a builder whose scope starts at this project

controls.label: Persona switcher
controls.does: changes whose view you see and what you may decide

controls.label: Lens switcher
controls.does: shows the same work for a purpose: business, concept, delivery, operations, compliance or insight

controls.label: Pause
controls.does: asks the project to stop at the next safe point

controls.label: Resume
controls.does: lets a paused project continue

controls.label: Answer
controls.does: records your answer as the owner's word

controls.label: Let Rihma assume
controls.does: takes the panel's proposal as an assumption with a due date

controls.label: Verdict buttons
controls.where: an Inbox card, or the decisions widget
controls.does: decides the card with your name and persona

controls.label: Report a change
controls.does: files feedback or a change; it is triaged and routed back

controls.label: Comment
controls.does: adds a remark without deciding anything; it can be promoted into a change

controls.label: Jump to (Ctrl+K)
controls.does: jumps to any page, project, view or open card

controls.label: Assistant
controls.does: answers questions about the cockpit and your projects, and proposes actions you confirm

controls.label: Customize
controls.does: rearranges, resizes, adds or removes the dashboard's widgets; Done saves your own layout

controls.label: Theme
controls.does: switches dark, light or system, the accent colour and the corners

controls.label: Density
controls.does: switches between comfortable and compact spacing

controls.label: Adopt an existing project
controls.where: New project, Start from: An existing project
controls.does: adopts an existing project from a folder on this machine or a git address: a folder is scanned first, one that is not a git repository is snapshotted into a baseline repository (your folder is never changed), and one with no code is offered as material for a new project instead; Rihmasto records its tests as a baseline and then monitors, maintains or improves it

controls.label: Scan the folder
controls.where: New project, after you give a folder (in An existing project, or a folder path as the need)
controls.does: shows what Rihmasto would read of the folder before anything is sent or created: each file read in full, summarised, only listed or skipped, with the reason (code becomes an inventory, secret-looking files are never opened, the budget reads the most telling files first and says what it cut) and the characters it comes to and where they would go; untick a file to leave it out, then create or adopt the project. The same map: `rihmasto scan <folder>`

controls.label: Confidential: keep on local models
controls.does: records the project as confidential: intake and every model call for it may go only to a model on this machine or a private network address; a role routed to a hosted model is refused with the role named and how to set up a local model (docs/guides/local-models.md), never sent. The setting is in the ledger
synonyms: do not send to the cloud

controls.label: New project
controls.does: starts a project from a need: its work profile and how it runs (a posture with its weights, or a maturity and mode)

controls.label: Log a signal
controls.does: records a need that arrived from the operation, to be triaged

controls.label: Validate a concept
controls.does: turns a concept into a project, after you edit its title, profile, maturity and mode

controls.label: Export evidence pack
controls.where: a project's Evidence tab and the Compliance lens
controls.does: exports a zip with the attestation, decisions, gate verdicts and the whole record, downloaded once

controls.label: Build the capability pack
controls.does: builds the latest release's capability pack, signed with your name; a new version only when what it names changed. Showing the pack never builds it

controls.label: Create an embed
controls.does: makes a chat window for a website that files feedback or needs; its key is shown once

controls.label: Autonomy cap
controls.where: the Compliance lens and the project header
controls.does: sets how far the factory may act alone, with a reason

controls.label: Intake summary
controls.does: shows side by side what your input stated, with its document and lines, what was put to a person and what was assumed, and which questions were not asked because they only restate your input (a question about anything more is asked, and a blocking one always reaches a person, quoting the lines it rests on)

controls.label: Track pill
controls.does: the project's one on-track answer (it carries every reason the health reads): whether the project is on track against its approved plan, not measured before a plan is approved, with a checkpoint due or an autopilot running, and opens the Track view

controls.label: Set checkpoints and a budget
controls.does: a plan owner picks the stage boundaries a person must look at, whether a due one holds the run, a due date and a cost budget

controls.label: I looked
controls.where: a due checkpoint in a project's Track view
controls.does: records, signed, that you looked at the stage; a run the checkpoint held goes on at its next pass

controls.label: Start the autopilot
controls.does: delegates the card kinds you choose to the factory's rules until a time and runs the project on its own, bound to a sandbox

controls.label: Stop the autopilot
controls.where: a project's Track view, while an autopilot holds it
controls.does: stops the run at once: its delegation is revoked and what it held back in the sandbox is released; a pass still under way delivers nothing more and ends at its next safe point, and then you run the project yourself to deliver

controls.label: Revoke a delegation
controls.where: a delegation in a project's Track view
controls.does: stops a delegation at once: its next card waits for a person

controls.label: Choose the outputs
controls.does: records which outputs the project delivers, with your name and why; choosing the web app with sign-in adds the paved road's sign-in to the product

controls.label: Build and download an output
controls.where: a project's Outputs tab, on each output's card
controls.does: builds one chosen output from the records and the release, signed with your name, and downloads it once

controls.label: Build every chosen output
controls.does: builds every chosen output at once; each card then offers its file as a one-time download

controls.label: Download a built output
controls.where: an output's card, after a build
controls.does: downloads the file a build just made; the link works once

controls.label: Modules
controls.where: Settings, and the first-run choice on a new factory
controls.does: chooses which parts of Rihmasto this factory or one project uses: a preset such as spec only or gate my code, or each module; a module that is off says what it would add, and the change is signed and recorded

controls.label: Revoke an embed
controls.does: stops a website's chat for good, signed with your name; a product owner, business owner or IT may, and it stays open while Integrations is off

controls.label: Project settings
controls.does: changes what was set when the project was made: its title, kind of work (template), mode and maturity, with a preview of what the change means for the questions, spec and plan already done; signed with a reason, and nothing is deleted

controls.label: Go back a step
controls.where: Project settings, and a project's What's next strip
controls.does: sends a project back to its material, questions, spec or plan so that step runs again; what it sets aside is kept as superseded, and a released project changes through the change loop instead

controls.label: Add material
controls.where: Project settings, and a project's What's next strip
controls.does: adds more of the request to a project later (text, or a file or folder path) and lets the panel ask only about what is new; the original request and every answer are kept

controls.label: What's next
controls.does: says what the project waits for, who can act, and the buttons that move it forward: a card to decide, a question to answer, a retry, material to add or a setting to change

controls.label: Look at the spec before building: Go or Skip
controls.where: a project's What's next strip, and its Inbox card
controls.does: at explore and demo maturity the factory waits once, before the first build, for a person's go-ahead on the spec: Go builds it, Skip builds it without the look; either is signed and the run goes on
synonyms: why does it wait before building

controls.label: Build without waiting for me
controls.does: turns off the go-ahead on the spec for this project: at explore and demo it builds the spec as written, without waiting for a person's Go or Skip

controls.label: Shape it in chat
controls.does: opens a conversation with Rihma to work out what is needed

controls.label: Start the conversation
controls.does: opens a new conversation, with a first message and a file or folder if you give them

controls.label: Send to Rihma
controls.where: Shape it in chat, a conversation
controls.does: sends your message; Rihma answers with one or two questions and updates the draft

controls.label: Attach a file or folder
controls.where: Shape it in chat, a conversation
controls.does: adds text, Markdown or a Word document, or a folder on the cockpit's machine, for Rihma to read

controls.label: Save the draft
controls.where: Shape it in chat, beside the conversation
controls.does: keeps your own words in the draft brief; Rihma leaves the fields you edited as you wrote them

controls.label: Create the project from this
controls.where: Shape it in chat, under the draft
controls.does: creates the project from the draft, with the work profile, mode and maturity you choose and Rihma's suggestion
synonyms: turn the chat into a project

controls.label: Open Models setup
controls.where: Settings, and Home while no model answers
controls.does: opens the page where each role's model and endpoint is set and tested

controls.label: Change a role's model
controls.does: points a role at an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and model, with its key as a variable's name or stored outside the repository

controls.label: Test a model
controls.does: sends the role's endpoint a tiny prompt and says how fast it answered, or the error

controls.label: Back to the shipped model
controls.where: Models setup, a role set on this machine
controls.does: takes the role back to the shipped routing

controls.label: On my own network
controls.does: declares a model server reached by name on your own network (this machine, a tailnet or a VPN) as local, so a confidential project may use it; addresses like 127.0.0.1, 192.168.x.x and 100.x.x.x count already

controls.label: Model presets
controls.does: fills the form for llama.cpp, Ollama or vLLM on this machine, OpenCode Go, or a hosted OpenAI-compatible provider

controls.label: Posture
controls.where: the project header and Project settings (the Posture chip), and How it runs in the New project dialog (a need or an existing project)
controls.does: chooses how a project runs (prototype, balanced, production or regulated) with priority weights for ux, security, compliance, speed and cost; shows what it will do before you choose, and what a change does now and later; lists what holds the project now (a go-ahead card and who decides it, an assumption to confirm, an evidence pack due before staging or production)

controls.label: Assess now
controls.does: reads the repository's main by rule from five perspectives and records a new assessment version signed with your name; with 'Ask the panel too' the panel's model proposes more, kept apart as opinions

controls.label: File as changes
controls.where: an adopted project's Assessment tab, below the findings
controls.does: turns the findings you tick into change cards from the assessment, triaged as new requirements so a business decision comes first

controls.label: AI tools in this project
controls.where: an adopted or attached project's Overview
controls.does: shows how the team's AI coding tools are set up in the repository, each with where it is: project instructions (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, .cursorrules, Cursor rules with their globs, Copilot, Windsurf and Cline rules), Claude skills with their bundled files, subagents, slash commands, hooks and permission rules, and MCP servers by name; and the build and test commands the instructions state. Nothing found is run; personal settings are listed, never read. Skills and MCP servers are candidates for Rihmasto's catalogue only, after a person approves. The same list: `rihmasto ide <pid>`

controls.label: Work on it from your IDE
controls.where: an adopted or attached project's Overview, beside AI tools in this project
controls.does: gives ready-to-paste MCP configuration for Claude Code (.mcp.json or claude mcp add), Cursor (.cursor/mcp.json) and Codex pointing at Rihmasto's own MCP server, signed with your name and persona, and says how a developer's change comes back: a workspace's submission through the gate on an adopted project, `rihmasto repo gate` on an attached one. The IDE is the inner loop, Rihmasto the outer loop. The same: `rihmasto ide <pid>`

controls.label: Copy the section
controls.where: Work on it from your IDE, on an adopted or attached project's Overview
controls.does: copies or downloads the text "Rihmasto's contract and open questions for your IDE agent" (the contract, what waits on a decision, how a change comes back, the rules) for you to paste into your project's AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md yourself; Rihmasto never writes into your folder. The same: `rihmasto ide <pid> --section`

controls.label: Runtime and faces
controls.where: a project's Releases tab, in its capability pack
controls.does: shows what a small capability needs where it runs (what starts it, its tools, model roles, integrations and secrets by name) and how to reach each of its faces: MCP, the OpenAI-compatible chat, the website embed and HTTP, with the command that serves it

controls.label: Access note
controls.where: the top bar, beside the person chip; on a narrow screen, the person menu
controls.does: says who signs decisions: with a single operator, personas are self-declared; with access enforced, the person the organisation's sign-in verified, the personas IT granted, when the session ends with the sign-in token, and where untrusted code runs (the isolation runner: the gate's tests, adoption's baseline, local products and Gnomon cells; the kernel scrubs a lane's .git before its own git runs there, refuses a cell's work that holds a nested repository, ignores replace refs and grafts, and copies the head's tests to the gate's base from git, never following a link). A name from the token that looks like a listed person's name (lookalike letters and invisible characters included) carries the subject after it; the key file takes public keys only
synonyms: cell refused for a nested repository
what the kernel does with a lane's .git
private key in the key file

controls.label: Data integrations
controls.where: a project's Plan tab and the plan's approval card
controls.does: lists the databases, warehouses, cloud storage, ERPs and APIs the product reaches: how, whether it writes there, and what data it touches. A person declares one with the command rihmasto integration declare; IT binds each on a paved road and approves it on a road card before delivery

controls.label: Open Runners
controls.does: opens the page that says which harness runs each role's cells and with what assurance

controls.label: Check the runners on this machine
controls.does: looks for Gnomon, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and a named command here, asks each its version, and says whether Docker can run the sandbox

controls.label: Choose a runner
controls.does: chooses the builder's or the verifier's runner for the factory or one project: Gnomon at once, another harness on a card IT decides with its version pinned, optionally in a docker sandbox

controls.label: Approve a runner
controls.does: approves or declines a runner waiting on IT; approved, it runs that role from then on and every round says it was checked after the run

controls.label: A project's cell runners
controls.does: shows what runs this project's builder and verifier and their assurance, with a link to change it in Settings > Runners

controls.label: Open Automations
controls.where: the sidebar; Home's card when the circuit breaker paused one; a project's Automations tab
controls.does: opens every automation across the factory, with scope filters and the history of runs

controls.label: New automation
controls.where: the Automations page header, or a project's Automations tab
controls.does: opens the builder: a trigger, an optional guard, an action, a scope and limits, with the summary the kernel writes before you save; it runs with your rights

controls.label: Start from a template
controls.where: the Automations page, or a project's Automations tab
controls.does: starts the builder from a common one: nightly re-gate, notify on release, re-scan a folder weekly, a cross-project dependency, ask after two failed gates, and the life-cycle ones: checks when a release reaches test, the probe check on promotion, a note when a concept is validated, a change proposal when the gate fails twice
synonyms: notify when a concept is validated

controls.label: Save the automation
controls.does: saves the automation, signed with your name and persona; it acts with your rights from then on

controls.label: Run now
controls.where: each automation on the Automations page or a project's tab
controls.does: runs it once on the scheduler's next tick, passing over its trigger and guard; the runs per hour still hold

controls.label: Dry run
controls.where: each automation on the Automations page or a project's tab
controls.does: says what the next tick would do and records nothing

controls.label: Pause an automation
controls.where: each automation on the Automations page or a project's tab
controls.does: stops it until someone resumes it; anyone may pause one

controls.label: Resume an automation
controls.where: each paused automation on the Automations page or a project's tab
controls.does: runs it again after a pause or the circuit breaker; its owner or IT may

controls.label: Edit an automation
controls.where: each automation on the Automations page or a project's tab
controls.does: changes its parts; the person who changes it owns it from then on

controls.label: Remove an automation
controls.where: each automation on the Automations page or a project's tab
controls.does: removes it for good; its runs stay in the ledger

controls.label: Project tags
controls.does: tags the project, so an automation scoped to a tag reaches it
